style.purpose: Advisory drawing profile, not an executable recipe or a trained model.
style.projection: Use the selected ALTTP top-down wall/floor convention.
style.pixel_clusters: Choose Oracle-style compact contours or ALTTP-style clusters per asset; retain that choice across its complete family.
style.lighting: Follow the selected primary crop's light direction and contact shadows; architecture references do not override it.
style.family_rule: Review floor, edge, wall, corner and doorway together before adding decorative detail.

tile_budget.scope: Example drawing canvas only; no ROM sheet, VRAM or palette allocation is established.
tile_budget.export_format: Generic SNES 3bpp example; a separate 4bpp profile may use 16 slots. Neither establishes Oracle import readiness.

color_policy.target_palette: Declare every target RGBA slot in the executable recipe; these role names do not assign colors. Review a separate palette profile before adding cloud or banner colors beyond this eight-slot family.
color_policy.sampling: Use a pinned source hash and an exact integer crop; explicitly map source RGBA colors or source palette indices.
color_policy.duplicate_colors: Preserve palette-index distinctions even when two slots have identical RGB values.
color_policy.transparency: Assign transparency deliberately; a rip sheet's key color is not automatically transparent.
color_policy.conversion: No implicit quantization, antialiasing, interpolation, palette blending or fuzzy style transfer.
color_policy.hardware_palette: Request palette export separately; the executable validator owns exact supported channel values.
